claim: Noirmoutier has 83 km of cycling paths and three signed thematic loops: From Beaches to Harbours (19.2 km), From Marshes to Mills (18.5 km) and From Gois to Forests (23.3 km), with 11 rental points and 3,000 bikes available.
quote: From Beaches to Harbours - 19.2 km (~2 hours)... From Marshes to Mills - 18.5 km... From Gois to Forests - 23.3 km... Total cycling paths: 83 km... 11 rental points with 3,000 bikes available

claim: Noirmoutier connects to the Vélodyssée (EuroVelo 1) via the Fromentine bridge cycle lane or the Passage du Gois at low tide, with the Bois de la Chaise loop linking the castle, the elegant villas, Plage des Dames and the L'Herbaudière fishing port.
quote: The island is accessible via La Vélodyssée route through two options... Fromentine bridge with cycle lane (safer alternative)... Bois de la Chaise district featuring elegant villas and the renowned Plage des Dames, plus the fishing port of L'Herbaudière

claim: Standard adult bike rental on Noirmoutier runs €8–18/day (€40–90/week) and e-bikes €20–40/day (€95–210/week), with shops in Barbâtre (NO 2 Roo), La Guérinière (No'vélo), L'Épine (Les Vélos de Paul) and Noirmoutier-en-l'Île (Vel'hop, L'Île à Vélo); L'Herbaudière is served by seasonal delivery only.
quote: Standard bikes (VTC): €8–12 (low season) to €14–18 (high season). E-bikes (VAE): €20–28 (low season) to €30–40 (high season)... L'Herbaudière: No service on-site; Vel'hop & No'vélo deliver seasonally

claim: Maximum Glisse, based at Port du Morin in L'Épine, runs a full multi-discipline school covering kitesurf, wingfoil, windsurf, catamaran, kayak, SUP and e-foil, and organises Raid catamaran trips around Noirmoutier on 6–7 and 20–21 June 2026.
quote: Main Base: Port du Morin, Digue SUD, L'Epine, Île de Noirmoutier... Sailing, Kitesurf, Wingfoil, Windsurfing, SUP, Kayak, Catamaran, E-foil... Raid 1 scheduled for June 6-7, 2026... Raid 2 scheduled for June 20-21, 2026

claim: Mouv'n Kite, the kitesurf school at the foot of the Noirmoutier bridge in Barbâtre, is open daily 7:45 AM–10 PM from March to November, making Barbâtre the island's main beginner kite spot.
quote: Mouv'n Kite welcomes students from March to November, 7 days a week, between 7:45 AM and 10 PM, depending on wind conditions. Barbâtre is considered the ideal beginner spot

claim: Sand-yachting (char à voile) on Noirmoutier is run by Sel ton Char from Plage de l'Océan in Barbâtre (and Plage de la Croix Rouge in July–August), open daily March to November for ages 8 and up under a state-certified instructor.
quote: Plage de l'océan (September 1 - June 31)... Plage de la Croix Rouge (July 1 - August 31)... de mars à novembre tous les jours... Activities begin at age 8 and up

claim: The Centre Nautique Municipal Fort Saint-Pierre at Plage des Dames is the island's largest sailing school, offering age-graded stages from 4 to 15+, a Topcat Avanti sport catamaran and foiling-dinghy (Birdyfish) instruction, with summer-program registration opening mid-March 2026.
quote: Avenue Georges Clemenceau - Plage des Dames, 85330 Noirmoutier-en-l'Île... Topcat Avanti, described as a 13.5-foot sport catamaran ideal for learning and advancement... Pas de stages de printemps - Prochains stages cet été... summer program registration opening mid-March 2026

claim: Hissez-Haut, the French Sailing Federation school in Barbâtre, takes children from age 5 on Optimist, Topaz and Hobie Cat 16 catamarans, windsurfing and wingfoil.
quote: Hissez-haut, a sailing school affiliated with the French Sailing Federation located in Barbâtre, welcomes children from age 5 and offers different supports including Optimist, Topaz and Hobie Cat 16 Catamarans, windsurfing and Wingfoil

claim: Noirmoutier Evasion rents double sea-kayaks at €25/1 h or €45/2 h per person and runs a guided 2-hour Escape Kayak with waterproof road-book bag for €30 per person, with wetsuit hire at €5.
quote: Escape Kayak (Guided Activity)... Duration: 2 hours, Cost: €30 per person... Double Kayak Rental: 1 hour: €25 per person, 2 hours: €45 per person... Wetsuits... €5 per person

claim: Guided salt-marsh visits with the saunier are run from June to September; a walk with Léna around the salt marshes is priced at €10 adult / €5 children 6–12, and several salt makers (Corbe, Nouvelle Brille, Marais Neuf) open their pans during summer.
quote: Salt makers offer tours of their own salt marshes from June to September... A walk around the salt marshes with Léna costs 10€ per person, with 5€ for children aged 6 to 12

claim: The Centre Équestre Horse Club de L'Herbaudière, 145 route de l'Herbaudière, is open 1 April–11 November 2026 and runs 2-hour morning beach rides governed by tide schedules (reserved for advanced riders) plus rides through the Luzéronde forest and salt marshes.
quote: 145 route de l'Herbaudière, 85330 Noirmoutier-en-l'île... Du 1 April 2026 au 11 November 2026... Two-hour beach rides are organized in the mornings based on tide schedules but are reserved for advanced riders
